_notes: FEETBURST v1 (-feetburst:<dir> harness, Assets/Scripts/FeetBurst.cs). Frame-accurate consecutive burst of the player's feet for the circling flickering whirlwind on the floor. The scene's own fighters and real CameraRig are used: the rig runs for settleSec in normal play (lock cam), then the camera pose + fov is frozen and re-applied every LateUpdate. Time.captureFramerate = captureFps and Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1/captureFps make ONE rendered frame = ONE sim tick, independent of the machine fps; every frame's Time.frameCount / Time.time is logged and a gap fails the run. States run in order: idle (the player stands), walk (moveDir = camera right rotated by walkDirDeg, optional reversal at walkReverseAtFrac of the burst), turn (the foe is moved on a circle of turnRadiusM around the player at turnDegPerSec so the player turns in place to face it, her own moveDir stays 0). Crops: cropW x cropH px of the native frame centred on the projected foot point (footYFrac = foot height from the crop bottom); the crop origin is logged per frame (feetburst_frames.csv). wide luma = wideW x wideH px around the feet, mean luma only; the wide REFERENCE is one full native frame PNG at the frames listed in refFrames. Run at native 2560x1600 (requireResolution) and WITHOUT -fast. Everything here is data.
